justification: 3b labelling polish (frontend display only): planning overlays render as a readable list with units ('Lot size: 450 m2', 'Acid sulfate: Class 5') instead of '2 items'; the Climate Disclosure card humanises empirical findings ('Urban heat: +7.3 C above surrounding areas (2016 data — most recent available)') instead of dumping internal manifest/snake_case units; long URLs in value cells wrap instead of overflowing.

pre_impl.existing_data: Verified live (14 Stanley, satellite on): environmental.overlays.value is a list of {layer_type,value} (acid_sulfate 'Class 5', lot_size '450'); satellite.climate_disclosure.value.empirical_findings is a list of {hazard,value,unit,data_date,confidence}.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Arrays of objects fell through formatValue to 'N items', and the climate value object dumped internal manifest/counts/snake_case units.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new data. Adds OVERLAY_UNIT map, OverlayList component, humanizeClimateFinding helper and ClimateCard, dispatched like the existing SeppHousingCard/TerrainCard special cases. break-words gains overflow-wrap:anywhere.
pre_impl.external_source_error: No fetching changed. Helpers guard null/empty and fall back to the generic card when the expected shape is absent.
pre_impl.frontend_type: Frontend only (TypeScript/React). OverlayItem/ClimateFinding typed; tsc --noEmit passes.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: 'Overlays: 2 items', a climate dump with 'degrees_c_above_baseline', URLs spilling out. After: an itemised overlay list with units, plain-English climate lines, wrapped URLs.

functions.name: humanizeClimateFinding
functions.input: a climate empirical finding {hazard, value, unit, data_date, confidence}
functions.output: a {label, detail} plain-English line; urban heat / extreme rainfall special-cased, others humanised generically
functions.if_none: returns null when value is missing; ClimateCard filters nulls and shows 'No climate hazards recorded' if none

functions.name: OverlayList
functions.output: a readable list with units appended from OVERLAY_UNIT (lot_size -> m2)
functions.if_none: renders 'None mapped at this property' when no overlay has both a layer_type and a value

values: N/A - no regulatory values. Overlay and climate values come from the section payload; only labels/units are formatted.
queries: N/A - no database or API query.

break_it.scenario: An overlay row is missing layer_type or value
break_it.what_happens: a blank or '[object Object]' row could appear
break_it.repro: OverlayList filters to o.layer_type && o.value != null && o.value !== ''
break_it.how: incomplete rows dropped; an all-empty list shows the 'None mapped' message

break_it.scenario: The climate section arrives without empirical_findings
break_it.what_happens: ClimateCard could render empty or crash on .map
break_it.repro: the dispatch only swaps in ClimateCard when Array.isArray(cd.empirical_findings); otherwise the generic card renders

break_it.scenario: A new hazard type not special-cased
break_it.repro: humanizeClimateFinding falls back to formatKey(hazard) + value + unit.replace(/_/g,' ')
break_it.how: the generic branch produces a readable label and de-underscored unit

post_merge.manual_verify: Run a brief with satellite on: overlays show an itemised list with 'Lot size: 450 m2'; the Climate card reads 'Urban heat: +7.3 C above surrounding areas (2016 data — most recent available)'; long source URLs wrap inside their card.
